prepare: K216_gateway_transaction.prepare unchanged; same staged host-program and immutable selected CPU/RAM binding
domain: Natural k216 selected hierarchy; descriptor count8; actual candidate predicates limited to firstfour records; fourth success computed, not replayed. Later candidates/fallback/other selectors/aliases/output errors remain excluded.
chronology: One ordered outer accepted-root stream from concrete execution. Accepted parent absorbs nested roots; no per-domain cursors/concatenation or live nested interception.
preservation: Exact surviving Pass87 and Pass103 CPU/RAM/journals; every missing old root must be enclosed by a new parent. Original modes and their negatives revalidated.
independent: Fresh concrete five-source windows; complete ordered writes/instruction provenance where available, full RAM/CPU/flags/PC/SP, continuation ownership, DMA/filesystem/services. Existing owned/inherited read laws revalidated through Pass102.
failure: Explicit restrictions decline; unexpected late child errors propagate. Missing/wrong oracle state or RAM and journal errors fail before commit. Same-boundary staged retry and existing partial-controller retry; fresh controller for an aborted full-program restart.
timing: Same process/build/input/Execution analysis, separate oracle acquisition. Sequential concrete/Pass87/Pass103/four-domain runtime times, plus isolated per-new-root probe/prepare samples. Single-run timings, not statistical benchmark claims.
